players: 8-10 (numbers below are for 8; '+1/+2' says what to add)
theme: Occupy and vacate: when someone moves, move into their space
focus: In possession: the 9 drops, the 8 runs beyond on the blind side and becomes the temporary 9; the far-side 8 fills the centre to keep two in the central lane
objectives: 8 moves away to drag their CM, 9 drops into the gap, 8 then runs beyond on the blind side to become the temporary 9
CB finds the diagonal pass into the dropping 9 or onto the 8's back foot
Far-side 8 fills the centre so we keep two in the central lane, and the 9 sets or plays round the corner
key_messages: "Someone moves, I move" - fill the space they leave
"Diagonal" - break lines with the diagonal pass, not the straight one
"Round the corner" - one-touch layoff into the run

blocks.title: Box pass and replace

diagram.caption: Central 9 drops to receive, the 8 fills the space they left, ball goes into the new central player. 2 defenders (not shown) passive, then live.

blocks.setup: One 20x20m grid. 8 players: 4 on the corners, 2 in the middle (the 9 and 8), 2 defenders who are passive for the first 5 minutes, then live. 9: a third central player (a second 8). 10: a third defender.
how: Central 9 drops towards the ball and receives; the 8 immediately runs into the space the 9 left.
9 lays it back to a corner or plays straight into the 8 in the new space.
8 plays out to the far corner; the 2 central players repeat from the other side.
Every 90 seconds the central pair swap with the defenders, then with 2 corner players.
blocks.link_to_theme: Introduces the core rule of the session: when someone vacates a space, someone else occupies it.
coaching_points: Drop with a check: move away first, then come short at an angle
Filling player arrives as the ball goes into the dropping player, not after
Corner players receive on the open side ready to play into the middle first time
blocks.activity_notes: Everyone is in the grid; roles rotate every 90 seconds so everyone gets the central role.

blocks.title: Drop and go: 9 drops, 8 becomes the 9

diagram.caption: 8 drags their CM away, 9 drops, 8 runs beyond on the blind side. CB chooses: 9 to feet, or diagonal onto the 8's back foot. Far 8 fills the centre.

blocks.setup: 45x40m (centre of the pitch, 23 to halfway), 2 mini goals on the end line. 8 players: blue CB, FB, 8, 9, far 8 v red CM and 2 CBs. 9: add a red second CM (passive at first). 10: add a blue 6 and make the red second CM live.
how: Near 8 moves away from the ball, taking their CM with them.
9 drops into the gap between the lines. If their CM jumps to the 9, the 8 spins on the blind side into the striker's spot.
CB reads it: pass into the 9 to turn (CM stayed with the 8) or diagonal onto the 8's back foot (CM jumped to the 9).
Far 8 comes inside to keep two in the central lane; 9 can set to them first time. Finish in a mini goal.
Red CBs passive for 6 minutes, then live. Rotate 3 players into red every 4 minutes.
blocks.link_to_theme: Teaches the 'temporary 9' rotation from the video and the diagonal passes that unlock it.
coaching_points: 9 drops on an angle so they can see the CB and the goal - not straight back
8 runs on their CM's blind side: behind them, out of their eyeline
Diagonal pass beats the line; a straight pass into a marked 9 doesn't
9 receiving under pressure: one-touch round the corner into the run, don't try to turn
questions: Their CM went with our 9: where's the space?
Why is a diagonal pass better here than a straight one?
progressions: Red CM chooses live who to follow
regressions: Coach tells the CM to follow the 9 or the 8 before the rep
blocks.activity_notes: All 8-10 involved every rep; reps reset from the CB every 15-20 seconds.

blocks.title: 3-zone game: break the line with a dropping 9

diagram.caption: Blue 5 build in zone 1, must get through zone 2 (their midfielder) to score. Ball into a player who arrived in a space a teammate just left = bonus point.

blocks.setup: 45x40m split into 3 zones, 2 mini goals on the end line. 8 players: blue 5 (2 CBs, two 8s, 9) v red 3 (1 midfielder who must stay in zone 2, 2 defenders in the end zone). 9: second red midfielder in zone 2 (5v4). 10: blue +1 (a 6), red +1 defender (6v4).
how: Coach feeds a blue CB in zone 1. Blue must get the ball through zone 2 (a pass or a carry) before they can attack the goals.
Goal = 1. Bonus point for any pass that breaks zone 2 into a player who arrived in a space a teammate just left.
Red win the ball: dribble it over the start line = 1 point.
After 10 minutes the red midfielder can follow the dropping 9 out of zone 2. Swap roles every 4 minutes.
blocks.link_to_theme: Forces the drop-and-go rotation, because a static 9 or 8 won't get through a compact red midfield.
coaching_points: The first movement creates the space, the second one uses it
Look for the third player: 9 drops, sets, the 8 who ran beyond receives
CBs: be patient, move the ball side to side until the rotation opens the diagonal
Far-side 8 tucks in to keep two in the central lane
progressions: Red midfielders can leave zone 2 freely
regressions: Red midfielder can't tackle, only intercept
Remove the red point for a turnover
blocks.activity_notes: Everyone plays; coach restarts with a new ball the moment a rep ends.

blocks.title: 4v4 (+ floaters): 9-spot bonus game

diagram.caption: 4v4 (+ floater). Goal from a temporary 9 - any player who arrived in the 9 spot after the 9 dropped - = 2.

blocks.setup: 50x40m, 2 mini goals at each end, yellow '9 spot' coned in front of each end. 8 players: 4v4 (CB, two 8s, 9 each). 9: 1 neutral floater for the team in possession. 10: 5v5 adding a FB.
how: Restarts always from the team's CB.
Goal = 1. Goal scored or assisted by a temporary 9 (a player who arrived in the 9 spot after the 9 dropped) = 2.
Coach freeze once every 4 minutes on a good or missed 'someone moves, I move' moment.
4 x 4-minute games, 1 minute rest. Last game: free play.
blocks.link_to_theme: Live recognition of when the striker's spot has been vacated and who needs to fill it.
coaching_points: Somebody must be in the 9 spot whenever we're attacking
Weeks 1 and 2 still apply: two per lane, FB in / 8 out / W in
Dropping 9 plays one or two touch - don't get turned over in midfield
progressions: Double points only if the move started with a diagonal pass
regressions: Floater plays even at 8 (rotate the role)
blocks.activity_notes: Everyone plays; ball-stocks behind both ends.

blocks.title: 4v4 / 5v5 on the half pitch: someone moves, I move
blocks.setup: Half pitch, full goal at one end (GK if one trains, otherwise 2 mini goals), 2 mini goals on halfway. 4v4, 4v4+1 or 5v5. Swap ends at 10 minutes.
how: Normal game.
Focus: when a teammate leaves a space, fill it within 2 seconds.
Coach tallies diagonal passes that break a line.
coaching_points: The 9 spot is never empty when we attack
Diagonal into the back foot of the runner
questions: When our 9 dropped, who went? Was anybody left in the centre?

safety: Shin guards and gum shields for all
Shots on the floor into mini goals in blocks 2-4
If a GK trains, they must be fully kitted before going in goal
reflection_prompts: Did the 8s run on the blind side, or in front of their marker?
Were the CBs patient enough to wait for the diagonal?
Is the far-side 8 tucking in, or is the centre left empty?
